dict.string: Priv AI reads your health data to provide AI-powered health insights. All processing happens on your device.
Priv AI does not write health data. This permission is required by the HealthKit framework.
Priv AI uses the microphone to record audio for on-device transcription.
Priv AI uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your audio recordings.
Priv AI needs access to your photos to analyze images with AI. All processing happens on your device.
Priv AI connects to Ollama on your local network for AI inference with larger models.
